findings.summary: For self-employed with withdrawal before 6 years, the calculator shows only an orange note and no number, so the reader's question goes unanswered.
In the year-4 breakdown, a large number (25,725) sits on an empty dashed box even though there is no result. It can be misread as the payout.
The securities-account comparison column is drawn as an empty dashed box, so it looks like missing data rather than a real amount.
Switching to self-employed empties year bars 1–5 in the bar chart, with no explanation next to the chart.
Small breakdown labels ('החזר המס הוסיף', 'המס לקח') don't make clear whether the tax refund goes into the fund or to the person.
